author: Insta360
description:
How does a Leica photographer turn an ordinary street into a photograph worth remembering? In this video, @stevensenshan  & @BobbyAnwar takes Insta360 Luna Ultra onto the streets of Copenhagen and shares his approach to street photography, including how he finds the right light, frames reflections, and anticipates moments before they disappear.

Bobby explains how he reads a scene, looks for interesting layers, waits for the right subject, and decides when to press the shutter. His approach shows how light, composition, timing, and patience shape the way a street photograph comes together.

Shooting with Insta360 Luna Ultra, Bobby explores Copenhagen's streets and shows how a compact gimbal camera fits into his photography workflow. Its portable design makes it easy to explore different perspectives and react quickly when something catches his eye.
Join Bobby for a street photography walk through Copenhagen and discover the techniques and creative decisions behind his shots.
